q: How many years do we keep tax invoices and the accounting books before destroying them?
answer:
Tax invoices and accounting books are kept for **5 years**, under the Framework Act on National Taxes.

The clock starts at the end of the business period (contract end or fiscal year end), not the date the document was written. Anything under litigation or audit is not destroyed even after its period has run. Destruction happens in January: the records desk lists what has passed retention, the owning team checks it, and it is then entered in the destruction log and shredded.

Source: RouteMind, Document retention table (`/v1/nodes/retention-table/body`).
